title: Pokémon Nightmare: Invasion - Battle! Professor Chen
description:
A twisted turn on Prof. Oak's encounter, making it a grim character and one of the principal antagonists of this creepypasta game.

I must admit the original midi is kind of poor, but the song is still useful in tense areas.
